threads.label: The treasure you seek
threads.text: Father William marked the witch's home and the Barrow Mound on your map. The treasure itself is still to be found.

threads.label: The thief in the cellar
threads.text: Trout and Dr. Uriah caught Naggeneen the Clurichen in the Golden Egg's basement. He had been stealing Quinn's alcohol.

threads.label: The black dragon
threads.text: One-armed George told you where its lair is. He says nothing pierces its scales and it will soon fly. Eric the Reeve offers one thousand gold for its body.

threads.label: Lady Hilda's offer
threads.text: She is a seasoned armored fighter, and she will join your dragon hunt if you pay her.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned
threads.text: He and his killer wasp will do anything that lets him kill, for one hundred gold a week. He refunds five gold a kill if he can do as he likes with the bodies.

threads.label: Brandonsford's missing shipments
threads.text: Nothing has come into town for months, and you still don't know why.

threads.label: Sir Phidipaldi's challenge
threads.text: He challenged Eric the Reeve to a duel at dawn, which Eric has not accepted. Eric is offended by the glove slap and by Sir Phidipaldi's false claims about George's dragon.

threads.label: Trout's Halfling Corps
threads.text: Trout recruited Squints, a halfling new to town, as a junior assistant. Trout owes him second pick of your first treasure, after the elite members. Until then he funds himself.

threads.label: The smith's mithril shirt
threads.text: Dunk scouted Warwick the smith's shop by night and spotted this magical chain shirt. Dunk says he has a plan to get it, and it could help against the dragon.

threads.label: Ingrid's sleeping potion
threads.text: Dunk agreed to help Ingrid the Alchemist dose Warwick in his house, which would get Dunk inside unnoticed. He gave her watered-down faun wine to make it, which may weaken the potion.

threads.label: Brandon's sword
threads.text: Father William says it lies in the Barrow Mound and is the only weapon that can kill the dragon. George says no one knows if the legend is true.

threads.label: Vivian the witch
threads.text: Your route to the Barrow avoids her house. You still don't know why fairies that once stayed hidden are now coming out more often.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah's promise to Father William
threads.text: He agreed to give penance at the Barrow Mound and to donate ten gold for its upkeep.

threads.label: The giant's stone cottage
threads.text: Squints pulled Brother Dirk, a captive, out of it, and you outran the waking giant. The man-eater is unharmed and may catch and eat anyone passing near.

threads.label: The fauns' wine
threads.text: Dunk drank it without effect, then traded a rabbit's foot for a faun's flask of it.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah and Ingrid
threads.text: They agreed that Father William is the worst. Ingrid denied his claim about her potions.

closing: You are in the woods north of town, across the field from the giant's stone cottage, with Squints and the rescued Brother Dirk. You are heading for the Barrow and pressing Dirk to come along rather than go home. Trout has told him he will report to Squints.
